# SwapPulse v0.2.0 — Identity and staking product layer

This is a backfilled historical release created from the preserved product-layer checkpoint.

## New features
- Wallet V2 assurance card with verification type/level, expiry and state.
- Account-recovery protection status and delay visibility.
- Chain-authoritative operator and delegation status.
- Staking lifecycle controls for self-stake increases, delegation, undelegation, withdrawal and operator exit.

## Updated behaviour
- Confirmed chain state became authoritative for staking balances and operator state.
- Base44 stake records remain useful as mirrors/history but no longer determine the primary live balance shown to users.
- Reconciliation was expanded to close completed lifecycle records and update unbonding state.
- Duplicate and in-flight staking operations gained additional server-side protection.

## Security/privacy
- Existing V2 fail-closed eligibility remains unchanged.
- Expired or revoked verification blocks new value-bearing staking/bridge actions while preserving the user's identity and existing on-chain stake.
- No extra private verifier evidence is exposed in the Wallet UI.

## Why
The V2 contracts and relay were already secure, but the product needed understandable user controls around that infrastructure. This release turns the chain state into usable Identity and community-staking UX without introducing a new trust path.
